name: @kaihacksai/kaal-hosting
description: KAAL Hosting: the host-facing KAAL Extension. It provides the filesystem operations and guarantees KAAL needs on Linux, Windows and macOS.

scripts.test:publisher: npm run build && node --test test/embed/conformance.test.mjs test/embed/hosting.test.mjs test/embed/architecture.test.mjs test/embed/intent.test.mjs test/embed/requirements.test.mjs test/plan/boundary.test.mjs test/plan/portability.test.mjs test/plan/interface.test.mjs test/plan/usage-skill.test.mjs test/publisher/verify.test.mjs test/publisher/release-record.test.mjs && node test/publisher/usage-mutations.mjs && node --test --test-name-pattern="^hosting/T(2[1-9]|3[01]|48|5[34]|75) " test/plan/release.test.mjs
scripts.prepack: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build && node test/publisher/manifest.mjs
